extraction.Name: Belle Bonser Harris
extraction.Refused/Protested: With protest. To the Commissioner of Indian Affairs, Washington, D.C. By authority of the Congress.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged it and it was mortgaged. Not mortgaged.
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered in 1918 at Williamsburg, Virginia, by mail. No application made for patent. Sold the land for $3000 cash. No debts settled with purchaser at time of sale. Did not make application for patent. Signed receipt for patent. Notarized in State of Virginia, City/County of Williamsburg, 1929.
